_comment: Template only. This is not a usable credential: the certificate below is a placeholder and LoadKeySet refuses a file with no parseable certificate. Copy to a private operator-owned file (mode 0600, no group or other bits) and pass it with --appstore-config-file.
_bundleId: The application's bundle identifier exactly as App Store Connect shows it. A notification for any other bundle is refused.
_environment: Production or Sandbox. A notification from the other environment is refused, so sandbox traffic can never move real entitlements.
_rootCertificatePEM: The pinned trust anchor, normally Apple Root CA - G3, as PEM. Apple publishes no JWKS for these notifications, so this is the only thing bounding who may sign one. A system trust store is deliberately not used: it would let any public CA mint a signer.
